correctness.rationale: For shattered d fixed two-element queries, all-one pattern requires at least two vertices outside support and all-zero pattern implies a size-two vertex cover. Every trace is union of <=2 incidence stars. Counting bounds 1+t+binom(t,2) and degree-one collision exclude VC>=5 and the n=7 VC four-set; explicit star-pair constructions supply lower bounds. For Littlestone, conditional family of centers meeting first query has dimension <=3 because any second query forces a child with <=4 concepts or a star family with dimension <=2. The supplied complete depth-four n=7 query tree has 15 internal nodes/16 distinct terminal centers; additionally an independent bitmask dynamic program computed exact VC/Ldim for every n=2..8: (0,0),(0,0),(1,1),(2,2),(3,3),(3,4),(4,4). The all-n classification rests on structural upper bounds and monotonic witnesses, not extrapolation from finite n.
